description: This file defines the InceptionApi class extending OpenAIApi, providing methods for streaming and non-streaming chat completions, including custom endpoints for edit and apply operations, and handling special tokens for edit requests.

classes.name: InceptionApi
classes.description: A class extending OpenAIApi that provides custom methods for handling chat, edit, and apply completions with special token handling and streaming support.

methods.name: editCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams edit completion responses from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: editCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Fetches non-streaming edit completion responses from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Overrides the chat stream method to route requests based on special tokens for next edit or apply.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Overrides the non-streaming chat method to route requests based on special tokens for next edit or apply.

methods.name: applyCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams apply completion responses from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: applyCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Fetches non-streaming apply completion responses from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Streams responses for the fim endpoint, handling SSE stream.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method not implemented, intended to list models.
